purpose: Live end-to-end Quick Answer cases. Each expected_value is the figure as reported in the company's own filing, recorded here so grading never depends on model output.
grading: A case passes only when the answer contains the expected figure AND at least one citation is graded 'verified' AND no citation is flagged. A right number with an unchecked citation is a failure.

cases.query: What was NVIDIA revenue in FY2025?

cases.source: NVIDIA 10-K FY2025: Data Center revenue $115,186 million

cases.source: Apple 10-K FY2025: total net sales $416,161 million
